title: Lead and Serve with the Single Marine Program
intro: Whether you're single, a geographic bachelor, or simply looking for more ways to get involved, the Single Marine Program (SMP) is your chance to lead, give back, and strengthen your connection with your fellow Marines and the community.

sections.heading: Take the Lead
sections.markdown: SMP empowers Marines to take on leadership roles by serving on their installation's SMP council. Represent your unit, collaborate with SMP staff, and engage with senior leadership—including the installation Sergeant Major. Your voice matters, and SMP is the platform to shape operational needs for single Marines.

sections.heading: Make a Real Impact
sections.markdown: Your feedback helps drive real change. By participating in SMP, you'll influence decisions that affect housing, recreation, and overall morale. Be the voice that ensures the needs of single Marines are not only heard—but acted on.

sections.heading: Serve Your Community
sections.markdown:
SMP is rooted in service. Each year, Marines contribute thousands of volunteer hours through programs like:

* Beach cleanups
* Installation Days of Service
* Local community outreach

Volunteering through SMP provides purpose and strengthens bonds between the Marine Corps and local communities.

sections.heading: Enjoy Unmatched Activities
sections.markdown:
Looking to unwind? SMP hosts fun, engaging events like:

* Paintball and sports tournaments
* Deep-sea fishing trips
* BBQs and holiday gatherings
* Group outings

New events are added often—connect with your SMP Coordinator or SMP council to stay in the loop.

sections.heading: Ready to Get Involved?
sections.markdown: SMP is your chance to lead, serve, and have fun. Visit your local [SMP office](https://www.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/single-marine-program) to join the council, volunteer, or sign up for upcoming events. Your involved makes a difference—for you, your fellow Marines, and your community.
